wins: Consistently achieved full reconnaissance reward (90) over the single episode, showing stable scanning behavior
Maintained engagement across 10 mentor calls, enabling step-by-step feedback incorporation
Documented detailed enumeration steps that can seed future exploitation attempts
fails: Failed to convert reconnaissance data into a successful compromise, resulting in 0% success rate
Repeatedly missed privilege escalation triggers after initial access, blocking mission completion
Spent excessive time on redundant scans, reducing time available for pivoting or exploitation
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase is solid with repeatable scanning patterns, but the pipeline stalls before achieving exploitation; focus next iterations on translating findings into actionable attack chains and reducing redundant work.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Recon step concludes without following through on identified vulnerabilities, leading to no exploitation attempts

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration using nmap's ssh-* scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with known CMS fingerprint
skill_cards.then_action: Extract banner, run targeted CMS-specific probing with nikto/whatweb

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial enumeration yields writable share or misconfigured service
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to post-enumeration path by checking for known privilege escalation vectors (sudo misconfig, weak creds)

memory_ops.reason: High success establishing baseline reconnaissance for SSH services
Consistent HTTP fingerprinting allowed identification of promising vectors

next_experiments.title: Close the loop from enumeration to exploitation
next_experiments.description: Following recognition of services, immediately trigger exploitation or privilege escalation checks instead of restarting scans; instrument decision gate to ensure actions occur within three steps

next_experiments.title: Limit redundant scans by caching service fingerprints
next_experiments.description: Track previously scanned ports/services and bypass re-scans unless change is detected, freeing time for escalation
